notes: Starting cards as posted: the objective and Jabba's Prize under 'Objective', then under 'Start': Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, They Must Never Again Leave This City, Power Of The Hutt, Cloud City: Security Tower, Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber, Carbonite Chamber Console, Fear Is My Ally; these count toward the list.
Qty 61 as published (60 without Jabba's Prize, which the objective deploys at the start of the game).
The author's update says he will keep They Must Never Again Leave This City in the Reserve Deck (to pull with a Twi'lek Advisor) and start 'the camp' instead; the list is kept as first posted.
